name: map-first offer: category-discovery query in default mode offers empirical cartography before any research
purpose: Verifies that on a category-discovery-shaped query without prefixes, the Step 1 interview offers the optional map-first empirical cartography (with a recommendation) and asks about the primary scope, while firing zero research queries.
prompt: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill: deep research on the experimental methods used to measure mitochondrial dynamics in live cells - what approaches exist and which are considered standard? I want a broad, well-organized view of the field.

checks.desc: the interview must offer the map-first / cartography option
the interview must ask which literature segment is the primary scope (or equivalent clarifiers)
the final assistant message must invite a user reply
zero evidence queries before the interview is answered
